messages:
tara: Quick announcement for next week94we're running a one-week Pet-Friendly Onsite pilot at the SF hub (Mon				Fri). TL;DR: up to 2 pets per person, registration required, waiver + behavior rules, pet relief area outside, and a small pet-sitting reimbursement option. Form link at the end.

jon: Ooh nice! A few questions: service animals? allergens?

tara: Short answers: service animals are always welcome and don't need the waiver; please DM People Ops for accommodations. For allergies, we	have an "Allergy Quiet Floor" (4th floor) where pets are not allowed. If you need that floor, ping me and we'll reserve a desk.

emily: What's the limit per day? Any size/breed rules?

tara: Limit 2 pets per employee per day. No aggressive breeds as defined by our vendor policy (we'll post the breed guidance). Pets must be on leash or in a carrier at all times in common areas. Facilities will designate a temporary indoor carrier/storage area if you need it.

facilities: Logistics: Exterior pet relief station set up by the bike racks (scooped & sanitized daily), a hand-wash station on the ground level, and a pet supply bin (litter bags, towel). Please use the labeled trash bins only. If a pet has an incident, report to facilities immediately so we can clean and assist.

megan: Is there a health/shot requirement?

tara: Yes				owners must certify pets are up to date on core vaccinations for dogs/cats and flea/tick prevention. Certification is a checkbox in the form (no need to upload records for the pilot).

rafael: What about temporary daycare / sitter reimbursements? I have a flight and need boarding for a day.

tara: We	have a small stipend for onsite pet care when travel or work requires it: up to $50/day, max 2 days during the pilot. Submit receipts to Expensify tagged "pet-onsite-2026". The stipend is for professional boarding/sitter services only (no cash gifts). We'll publish a vetted pet-sitter list (background-checked vendors) tomorrow.

jon: How do we register and get a pet pass?

ops-bot: pet-passes: Registration form live at https://tiny.redwood/pet-pass. Once approved, you'll get a QR pass emailed within 24hrs. Passes needed for lobby check-in.

emily: Any liability waivers?

tara: Short form waiver on the registration: acknowledges you	keep pets supervised, handle cleanup, and accept liability for pet-related damages. Service animals excluded. For aggressive behavior or repeated violations we may revoke pet privileges.

megan: If someone is allergic while we're onsite, how do we handle?

facilities: We'll enforce the Allergy Quiet Floor and provide HEPA air purifiers in common rooms that request them. If an allergy incident occurs, staff should move to the reserved quiet floor and People Ops will work on temporary desk moves.

rafael: Are puppies/kittens allowed? (still being potty-trained)
tara: Puppies/kittens allowed but owners must ensure they are sufficiently house-trained for indoor times. Repeated accidents may result in temporary suspension of pet privileges.

jon: Anything about noise (barking)?

facilities: Keep pets calm. If persistent noise is reported, facilities will issue a friendly reminder and may ask owners to move to an outdoor break area. Repeat issues = revocation.

megan: Will there be a microchip/ID check?

tara: No microchip check for the pilot, but we recommend up-to-date ID tags.

emily: Will snacks / catered food change because of pets?

tara: Catering teams will label food items clearly and avoid open buffet style in shared rooms. Please avoid feeding pets in shared meeting rooms.

ops-bot: calendar-update: Pet-Friendly Onsite event blocks added for next week on the SF hub calendar.

tara: Final note: this is a trial	proactive pilot to learn what works. Please register if you	intend to bring a pet. Form: https://tiny.redwood/pet-pass. If you have immediate concerns DM People Ops or facilities. Thanks!
